examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: after a plural noun or pronoun: вы все

examples.text: И знаешь, что самое главное? Всем всё равно.
examples.trans: And you know the main thing? Nobody cares.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'town, city' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
Gum? I didn't have enough money.

meanings.en: to put, do with, dispose of (colloquial)
meanings.note: Куда ты дел...? = Where did you put / What did you do with...?

examples.text: Куда ты дел их деньги на новое здание?
examples.trans: Where did you put their money for the new building?
Where did I put the keys?

examples.text: Да? А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Really? Then ask him where he put the computer lab.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'friend' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to live'.

examples.trans: I live in a communal flat.

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

meanings.note: жить на зарплату = to live on one's salary

examples.text: Эдуард Владимирович учёный, и он живёт на зарплату.
examples.trans: Eduard Vladimirovich is a scholar, and he lives on a salary.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
He's very good with his hands.

examples.text: Товарищ генерал, операция называется Золотой ярд.
examples.trans: Comrade General, the operation is called Golden Yard.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
Thank you, Marina. Sorry, I'm in a hurry.

examples.text: Как интересно! А в Москве ты про меня гадости рассказываешь.
examples.trans: How interesting! And in Moscow you go around saying nasty things about me.

examples.text: А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Ask him where he put the computer lab.

examples.text: Да? А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Really? Then ask him where he put the computer lab.

meanings.note: joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Не надо кричать. Хорошо, я буду сегодня.
examples.trans: There's no need to shout. All right, I'll be there tonight.

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: Wait, where are you two going?

мерить.gloss: to measure, judge; to try on

meanings.note: мерить по себе = to judge others by oneself

examples.text: Слушайте, не надо всех мерить по себе!
examples.trans: Listen, don't judge everyone by yourself!
She is trying on a new dress.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('new').

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: He will hand over the money.

examples.text: Потом надо отдать москвичам твои деньги из подвала.
examples.trans: Then I have to give your money from the basement to the Moscow people.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'куда').

examples.trans: Where does that word come from?
Thief, thief. Where does that word come from?

meanings.note: я деньги не печатаю = I don't print money
платить за + accusative = to pay for

examples.text: А вашу работу вернуть можно. И мы хорошо платим.
examples.trans: But we can get your job back for you. And we pay well.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'арить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to give (as a present)', paired with 'дарить'.

examples.text: А вы мне тоже айфон подарите?
examples.trans: Will you give me an iPhone too?

meanings.note: + dative of the buyer: 'продать соседке' = to sell to the neighbour

examples.trans: I'll sell it to the neighbour.

examples.text: Ну, как знаешь. Продам его Клавдии Викторовне.
examples.trans: Well, suit yourself. I'll sell it to Klavdia Viktorovna.

meanings.note: + 3rd person verb: 'пусть строят' = let them build

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

examples.text: А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.en: to ask (a question, or someone: спросить у кого-то)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'просить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to ask', paired with 'спрашивать'.

examples.text: А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Ask him where he put the computer lab.

examples.text: Да? А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Really? Then ask him where he put the computer lab.

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'too, also' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Мы же здесь выросли. И о людях тоже надо думать.
examples.trans: After all, we grew up here. And you have to think about people too.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: to threaten, to pose a threat to

examples.text: Конфликты с соседями угрожают здоровью подсудимого.
examples.trans: Conflicts with the neighbours threaten the defendant's health.

examples.text: Эдуард Владимирович учёный, и он живёт на зарплату.
examples.trans: Eduard Vladimirovich is a scholar, and he lives on a salary.

examples.text: Учёные говорят, что она даже полезнее чёрной!
examples.trans: Scientists say it is even healthier than black!

meanings.note: plural-only noun: эти часы = this watch

examples.text: Видишь эти часы? Это швейцарское золото.
examples.trans: See this watch? It's Swiss gold.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: any thing at all, not a particular one

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.
Are you doing anything about it?

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'fur coat' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: И откуда у Аллы Евгеньевны новая шуба!
examples.trans: And where Alla Yevgenyevna got a new fur coat!

examples.text: Который ему город подарил! И откуда у Аллы Евгеньевны новая шуба!
examples.trans: Which the city donated to him! And where Alla Yevgenyevna got a new fur coat!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
